title: CollageMaker LLM Usage Analysis and Report Generation
outcome: Generated consolidated HTML and JSON LLM usage reports for CollageMaker project. Discovered multiple bugs in the analytics skill through review. Reports written to BlogPosts/references/ directory.
key_decisions: Used --since 2026-05-10 flag to capture all-time data, though project path only has sessions from July 1
Launched general subagent for code review since world-review returned empty results
Created session-summary.json template in references/ directory (was missing)
learnings: _resolve_date() bug: str(None) produces 'None' string used as SQL parameter - works by accident due to ASCII ordering
Multiple CollageMaker paths in DB: sessions split across 3 directory paths, report only covers the github.io path
build_productivity.productive_sessions can exceed total_build_sessions due to counting ALL sessions on commit dates
Hardcoded phase dates in merge.py are from a different project and produce empty phases for CollageMaker
Cost summary uses flat rates while model_pricing uses per-model rates - produces inconsistent totals
Cache estimation only counts assistant messages, excluding sessions with only user messages
next_steps: Fix _resolve_date() in queries/utils.py and generate_report.py to default to today's date when until=None
Fix build_productivity.productive_sessions to count only build sessions on commit dates
Make phase dates configurable or remove hardcoded phases from merge.py
Add explicit pricing for agents-a1 and big-pickle models in model_pricing.py
Document cost calculation methods and their differences in SKILL.md
Consider merging sessions from all CollageMaker paths or documenting the path-specific behavior
